subject: Foundry Health pilot onramp — request for one-time onboarding concession
messages:
From: Amelia Cho <amelia@foundryhealth.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 4 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot program pricing — onboarding concession request

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency and cost profile for our inference workloads. We're ready to run a 3-month technical pilot (estimated avg 200k tokens/day, burst to 800k/day) but need a more attractive onramp to get exec buy-in.

Specifically we're asking for:
- A one-time onboarding credit or 50% off the first 3 months of usage OR a $25k onboarding credit against usage.
- A reduced token rate for the first 6 months (we can commit to discuss a 12-month renewal if pilot metrics hit thresholds).

We're budget-constrained for Q2 but are prepared to sign an MAA and commit to a 12-month commercial contract on successful pilot completion. Can you advise what exceptions you can offer and what approvals you need?

Best,
Amelia Cho
Sr. Procurement Manager
Foundry Health

--
Attachment: Foundry_RFP_summary.pdf (see pilot sizing)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 4 May 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot program pricing — onboarding concession request (Foundry Health)

Team — forwarding Foundry's ask. Short summary:
- Pilot: 3 months, avg ~200k tokens/day; pilot could convert to 12-months on success.
- Ask: either 50% off first 3 months or $25k onboarding credit + reduced token rates for first 6 months.

I've attached a draft MAA and a quick pricing calc for the pilot scenarios (pricing_calc.xlsx, Foundry_MAA_v1.docx). We need VP/CFO approval for any deviation from list pricing or onboarding credits > $10k.

Asks:
1) Can Sales approve a one-time concession for pilot to secure the proof-of-value?
2) If yes, what guardrails should we require (usage floors, PO, renewal commitment)?
3) Legal/RevOps: any immediate redlines in the attached MAA?

Timing: customer needs an answer by EOD Tuesday PST to stick to their procurement cadence.

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0113

Attachments: Foundry_MAA_v1.docx, pricing_calc.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, markus_klein@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 5 May 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot program pricing — onboarding concession request (Foundry Health)

Quick thought — the customer's willingness to convert looks plausible but we should confirm expected post-pilot ARR. If conversion ARR is under $120k/year the $25k credit is a high CAC hit.

If we do a credit, suggest we:
- Cap the onboarding credit at $25k or 18% of first-year committed ARR (whichever is lower).
- Require a signed PO and a 12-month renewal commitment or a 6-month minimum usage floor.

I'll run the sensitivity on the pricing calc and upload results to the shared Drive.

- Ben
Senior Director, Sales
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, markus_klein@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 5 May 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot program pricing — onboarding concession request (Foundry Health)

Attached a short revenue impact memo (revenue_impact.pdf) — baseline, downside, and required minimums. Key points:
- If Foundry converts to our standard mid-market tier at expected usage, ARR ~ $210k.
- $25k onboarding credit reduces first-year revenue by ~12% (no churn assumed).
- Risk mitigation: add a step-up clause — discounted token rate only for first 6 months, revert to list thereafter; require PO and signed MAA with auto-renew for 12 months unless notice.

Recommendation (my vote): Approve a conditional onboarding concession: 18% credit on first 3 months (or cap $20k), contingent on signed MAA + PO and mandatory renewal/commitment language. If Sales prefers a flat $25k credit, require 12-month committed ARR >= $150k.

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: revenue_impact.pdf
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 5 May 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot program pricing — onboarding concession request (Foundry Health)

Thanks for the analysis. I approve a one-time onboarding concession with the following conditions: 
- Concession: up to $25,000 onboarding credit OR equivalent off the first 3 months (whichever is lower).
- Guardrails: signed MAA and PO executed prior to credit being applied; 12-month commercial commitment with automatic renewal clause; step-up to list rates after 6 months.
- Operational: RevOps to flag deal and prevent any further discounts without VP-level re-approval.

Grace — please confirm you will get PO and MAA signatures and capture the commitment in HubSpot (deal id: RINF-2026-5121). Once PO is in hand, you have authority to accept the concession.

Markus Klein
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference
